description: A natural photograph depicting a wide, unobstructed view of the open sea at twilight. The expansive sea surface is a deep, dark blue with visible waves and ripples extending towards a flat horizon line. The sky exhibits a gradient from dark blue at the top, transitioning to lighter blues, and then soft orange and pink hues along the horizon, characteristic of either dawn or dusk. A few thin, wispy clouds are scattered horizontally near the horizon. This image serves as a visual reference for the "Open sea" land cover category, representing open water of seas and oceans outside coastal waters as defined in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) nomenclature.
